system.description: The logewurm can take the physical form of any creature it chooses for an unlimited duration, then return to its original form whenever it wishes. It retains none of its dragon’s physical attributes in this form and is therefore vulnerable. It can use this transformation only once per year.
system.summary: Adopts the chosen form’s physical traits, movement and attacks while retaining health points.
